_comment: NFR-P1 performance budget for the admin workspace shell (TP1-07, P1-12). check-lighthouse.mjs runs Lighthouse against each page and fails if the budget is breached. NFR-P1 IS the LCP budget: the shell loads and is interactive in 2.5s or less on a mid-range laptop on broadband, so the hard budget is desktop form factor, LCP <= 2500ms (observed ~770ms CI median under the fixed device model). tbtMs and perfScore are SECONDARY guards against a gross interactivity regression, not the NFR. The shell demo is gated off in a normal prod build, so build + start with NEXT_PUBLIC_ENABLE_GALLERY=1 before running.
_comment_stability: This gate is STABILISED against CI-runner noise (ADR-0032): (1) throttlingMethod is forced to 'simulate' with the EXPLICIT, fixed `throttling` device model below, so the score models a fixed mid-range laptop on broadband via Lantern rather than the shared runner's raw, drifting CPU; (2) each page is measured `samples` times and the budget is checked against the MEDIAN, so a single flaky run cannot flip the gate; (3) the e2e workflow pins Chrome and exports CHROME_PATH. The 600ms tbtMs headroom still catches a real doubling of blocking time without flaking on residual jitter.
